description:
Configure Magento sales email notifications for the operations team. Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales Emails. 

1. For 'Order' emails: Send a BCC copy to 'manager@nesthome.com'.
2. For 'Invoice' emails: Send a separate email copy to 'accounting@nesthome.com'.

Save the configuration. If you are not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!.
